claims.nodeLabel: CEFAA / SEFAA - Chilean anomalous aerial phenomena office, Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil
claims.text: The office publishes resolved-case bulletins monthly; as at 12 August 2026 the most recent were 'Casos Julio 2026' (3 August 2026), 'Casos Junio 2026' (6 July 2026) and 'Casos Mayo 2026' (4 June 2026), with resolved-case archives by year back to 2018.

claims.nodeLabel: CEFAA / SEFAA - Chilean anomalous aerial phenomena office, Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil
claims.text: 'Somos la Sección de Estudios de Fenómenos Aéreos Anómalos (SEFAA, antiguamente CEFAA), un organismo dependiente de la Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil (DGAC) de Chile ... Nuestra misión es clara: apoyar la seguridad de las operaciones aéreas de nuestro país.'

edges.label: Chile's civil-aviation UAP unit used as a model and proposed partner
edges.note: The Sky Canada report singles out Chile alongside the U.S. and France as a coordinated, transparent model, describing SEFAA as the official Chilean body for collecting and scientifically studying UAP that 'operates within the General Directorate of Civil Aeronautics (DGAC).' Recommendation 13 tells the proposed Canadian lead organization to establish partnerships with SEFAA (Chile) among others.
